purpose: Controlled public-belief continuation-policy diagnostic; no optimization and no strength qualification.

scope.selection: One reused development position per count/rule/action cell.

model.choice: Retained H200 update29 baseline; no claim it is universally strongest.

control.comparison: Matched first48 samples from384-sample records; same public worlds, root actions, and continuation cap.

treatment: Frozen learned policy acts for all players after the root move. Automatic single-legal-action turns do not require inference.
fixed_root_shortlist: Same six-proposal reference shortlist; do not add neural proposal in this causal comparison. Report its coverage separately.
analysis: A/B winner-set stability, ties and disjoint winners.
Select neural and mixed winners in A using a fixed incumbent-then-shortlist tie break, compare their outcomes in independent B.
Audit every hash, exact cells, both batches and every terminal continuation. Capped results cannot be silently converted to defeats.
Measure engine/IPC versus inference wall time before selecting subsequent compute.
follow_up: Target reliability is insufficient for promotion. A policy-guided teacher must improve full held-out development matches against independent frozen opponents before large-scale retraining or final qualification.
